race.comment: TERRITORY MAN (7) sat handy first-up but just felt the pinch late when run down by Rock Fest in a solid first-up performance. He now gets Lane on board from another good barrier and getting straight out to the mile doesn't look an issue. Comes through a strong race fresh and can land the knockout blow this time. TEX 'N' CEE (10) made it back-to-back wins last start when running away to score impressively over 1400m at Belmont. He's a 3YO on the rise and being out of G1 Northerly winner Kay Cee, the mile doesn't look an issue. Has tactical speed and can continue through the grades. VAMPI QUEEN (11) is racing in hot form, but got too far back here a fortnight ago. Thompson rides now and with a bit of luck, she can get back to winning ways. DEFENDING (2) was too good here last week and has to be included on the quick turnaround. JAVELIN STRIKE (6) lands in a tougher race here, but is in a purple patch of form and has to be considered.
